name: final_open_frac
description: how far open the drawer is at the end (0 = shut, 1 = fully open)

name: max_open_frac
description: the furthest the drawer was opened at any point in the attempt

name: ends_open
description: 1 if the drawer is open to within the task's tolerance at the end, else 0

name: steps_to_open
description: steps taken to first reach the fully-open position (episode length if never)

name: drawer_slipped_back
description: how much of the opening was given back after the furthest point (fraction)

name: frac_steps_drawer_open
description: fraction of steps with the drawer at the fully-open position

name: mean_handle_to_target
description: average distance from the handle to its fully-open position (m)

name: mean_hand_to_handle
description: average distance from the hand to the drawer handle (m)

name: frac_steps_hand_at_handle
description: fraction of steps with the hand touching-distance from the handle

name: frac_steps_fingers_closed
description: fraction of steps with the fingers closed rather than splayed open

name: frac_steps_pulling_handle
description: fraction of steps where the hand is on the handle and the handle is actually moving

name: mean_action_magnitude
description: average size of the commanded movement each step (0-1)

name: mean_action_change
description: average step-to-step change in the command — how jerky the motion is

name: hand_path_length
description: total distance the hand travelled over the attempt (m)
